title: Slack Desk Booking: The Officely Alternative to Envoy's Slack Integration
summary: Compare Officely and Envoy’s Slack integrations for desk booking, office-day coordination, setup, notifications, and workplace visibility.
body_markdown:
## Officely vs. Envoy Slack Integration at a Glance


Choosing Slack desk booking software starts with a practical question: can employees reserve desks and coordinate office days in the collaboration tool they already use? Officely is a desk-booking and flexible-office-management app that lives in Slack and Microsoft Teams. Envoy also supports desk actions in Slack, alongside workflows for visitors, deliveries, meeting rooms, and workplace status updates.


The Officely Slack integration focuses on desk booking, work-location updates, office-day coordination, and workplace visibility. Officely also supports the same core use case in Microsoft Teams.


The Envoy Slack app lets employees register to come on-site, book or cancel desks, invite visitors, receive visitor and delivery notifications, and check into pre-booked meeting rooms[\[1\]](https://envoy.help/en/articles/7947825-using-slack-with-envoy) . Employees can also share their work location through their Slack status and respond to notifications with one click.


This comparison focuses on employee workflow, setup, coordination, availability, and office-use visibility. It does not compare interactive floor plans, IWMS or CAFM functions, or enterprise facilities-management suites.

## How Desk Booking Works Inside Slack and Microsoft Teams


Desk booking works best when it fits into the employee’s normal workday. Instead of maintaining a spreadsheet or asking “Who’s in?” across several channels, employees can update their plans, check colleagues’ locations, and reserve an available desk from Slack or Teams.


### How Slack Desk Booking Works


The Officely Slack integration keeps the employee workflow inside Slack:


1. **Add Officely to Slack.** Connect the app and make it available to your team.
2. **Update your work location.** Employees use[Officely’s Slack integration](https://getofficely.com/integrations/officely-slack) to indicate whether they will work from the office, home, or while travelling.
3. **Review where colleagues are working.** Employees can see their teammates’ planned locations before selecting an office day.
4. **Choose an office day.** Officely provides suggestions that help employees identify suitable days to come in.
5. **Check desk availability.** The[desk-booking software](https://getofficely.com/solutions/desk-booking-software) shows real-time availability in Slack and Microsoft Teams.
6. **Reserve a workspace.** The employee selects an available desk and completes the reservation from Slack.


This workflow connects the desk decision with the social part of hybrid work. An employee can choose a day when relevant colleagues plan to attend, then check whether a suitable desk is available.


Teams should confirm during evaluation how booking confirmations and reminders appear for their chosen configuration. Interactive floor-plan functionality is not part of this documented workflow.


### How Microsoft Teams Desk Booking Works


The Officely Microsoft Teams integration follows a similar employee journey:


1. **Connect Officely to Microsoft Teams.** An administrator selects Teams and follows the integration instructions.
2. **Update your work location.** Team members indicate where they will work directly in Microsoft Teams.
3. **Set a routine if needed.** Employees with regular hybrid schedules can define a recurring work-location routine.
4. **See where colleagues are working.** Employees review office, home, or travel plans and coordinate attendance from that visibility.
5. **Check availability and book.** The[Officely Microsoft Teams integration](https://getofficely.com/integrations/officely-microsoft-teams) supports desk booking within Teams.


Location updates and desk reservations remain within Microsoft Teams. That makes the Officely Microsoft Teams integration relevant to companies where Teams is the main employee collaboration platform.


Officely can also make other workplace resources bookable in Slack and Teams, including meeting rooms, lunches, and office dogs. These options sit alongside the main desk-booking workflow rather than replacing it.


## What Employees Actually Do in Officely and Envoy


Spreadsheets, email threads, and improvised channel messages split office planning across several places. Employees may know that desks exist without knowing who plans to attend, or they may choose an office day before checking availability.


Officely brings work-location updates, colleague visibility, real-time desk availability, and reservations into Slack or Teams. It uses those collaboration platforms as the primary employee interface for hybrid team coordination.


Envoy provides Slack-based actions through its app. Employees can open the Home tab to view their work schedule, schedule or register an office visit, and view or change a desk.


Envoy also supports a command-based flow:


- ` /envoy-desk` displays the employee’s desk.
- ` /envoy-in` checks the employee in.
- ` /envoy-out` checks the employee out.
- ` /envoy-register` registers the employee to come on-site.
- ` /envoy-schedule` displays the employee’s schedule.


These are functional Slack workflows. Teams comparing the Envoy slack integration with Officely should decide whether they prefer Envoy’s app tabs and commands or Officely’s Slack and Teams-centered coordination model.

Envoy does not require employees to leave Slack for every desk action. Its documentation explicitly supports booking and cancellation through the Slack app. The distinction concerns the broader employee experience: Officely centers desk booking and hybrid coordination in Slack and Teams, while Envoy combines desk actions with several visitor and workplace workflows.


## Admin Setup and Launch Considerations


A smooth launch starts with the collaboration platform, employee access, reliable desk-availability information, and clear booking expectations. Configuration details vary, so administrators should separate documented integration steps from settings that need confirmation during evaluation.


### Setting Up Officely for Slack or Teams


Officely’s setup flow begins by adding the app to Slack or Microsoft Teams. The administrator follows the platform connection instructions, invites the team, and can start booking in minutes.


The available integration information establishes the connection and employee workflow. It does not define specific permission requirements, desk-inventory import procedures, booking windows, approval chains, policy-exception processes, or floor-plan configuration. Ask about those details if they form part of your workplace policy.


A practical rollout should also explain how employees choose office days and when they need to reserve a desk. Clear instructions help people distinguish a work-location update from a completed desk reservation.


### Setting Up Envoy for Slack


Envoy requires a Slack administrator to enable the integration. The documented Envoy Slack setup process is:[\[2\]](https://envoy.help/en/articles/3453659-slack)


1. Open **Integrations > All Integrations** in Envoy.
2. Search for Slack and select **Install** .
3. Select or sign in to the relevant Slack team.
4. Review the requested permissions and allow access.
5. Optionally choose a workspace to block from messaging.
6. Continue and complete the setup.
7. Confirm that the integration appears as enabled.


Envoy matches employees using their email addresses. An employee must use the same email address in the Envoy employee directory and the Slack team to receive bot notifications.


Employees and administrators must also enable Slack notifications in their individual Envoy notification settings. This step should form part of onboarding and launch testing.


Envoy’s optional visitor configuration can send notifications to a selected Slack channel. Administrators can enable host replies and approvals for unexpected visitors. These settings apply to visitor notifications and do not establish desk-booking approval policies.


**Pre-launch checklist**


- **Choose the collaboration platform.** Confirm whether employees will use Slack, Microsoft Teams, or both.
- **Connect the app.** Complete the documented administrator installation steps.
- **Invite or onboard employees.** Explain where employees update their location and book a desk.
- **Confirm availability data.** Ask the workplace team to check that employees can find the desks they expect to reserve.
- **Set booking expectations.** Explain when employees should update their office day and complete a reservation.
- **Test notifications where relevant.** Use test accounts to confirm that intended recipients receive the correct messages.
- **Run a small pilot.** Start with a defined group and review the employee workflow before a wider rollout.


Some checklist tasks require internal coordination rather than product automation. Assign an owner for the pilot, employee guidance, and feedback.


## Availability, Office-Day Coordination, and Booking Rules


A desk reservation has more value when employees can select a day alongside the colleagues they need to meet. Availability and attendance visibility connect the physical workspace with the reason for travelling to it.


### See Who Is Planning to Be In


Officely shows whether people plan to work from the office, home, or while travelling. It also provides office-day suggestions based on the information available in the platform.


The[“Who’s In” feature](https://getofficely.com/blog/why-officely-beats-envoy-for-slack-based-desk-booking) gives teammates visibility into office plans. An employee can review planned attendance before deciding when to commute, arrange an in-person discussion, or reserve a workspace near their team.


This workflow supports intentional office attendance. Managers and employees can coordinate around shared plans instead of relying on scattered messages sent at different times.


### Use Availability to Reduce Booking Conflicts


Real-time desk availability lets an employee identify an available workspace before making a reservation. It also gives the employee useful context when the preferred office day is busy.


The documented capability concerns visibility into current availability. It does not establish a particular technical method for preventing double bookings, so teams with detailed conflict rules should confirm how those rules work during evaluation.


Envoy employees can register to come on-site, book or cancel a desk reservation, and view or change their assigned desk in Slack. That provides a direct reservation workflow for teams using the Envoy app.


### Separate Documented Controls From Assumptions


Coordination features, availability information, and approval controls solve different workplace problems. Keep them separate when assessing each product:


- **Employee-facing coordination:** Officely shows planned work locations and helps teammates choose office days together.
- **Desk availability:** Officely displays real-time desk availability before an employee reserves a workspace.
- **Envoy desk actions:** Employees can register on-site and book, cancel, view, or change a desk through Slack.
- **Visitor-approval controls:** Envoy can support approvals for unexpected visitors through Slack. This is a visitor workflow, rather than evidence of desk-booking approvals.
- **Desk and attendance policies:** The available product information does not document specific Officely desk approvals, attendance-policy exceptions, or custom booking rules.


If your organization requires minimum office days, booking approvals, or exception handling, ask each vendor to demonstrate the exact administrator and employee flow. Review how the configuration applies across teams, locations, and working patterns.


## Office Visibility and Analytics for Hybrid Workplace Decisions


Officely provides analytics on how the office is used. Managers can review office-use information when assessing workplace demand, capacity needs, and how employees use shared space.


Employees also share where they plan to work, while teams can see who will be in the office. This gives workplace teams planned-attendance visibility alongside desk-booking activity.


The documented scope covers office-use analytics and attendance visibility. During evaluation, confirm the available reports, data fields, policy controls, and reporting schedule required by your workplace team.


Officely is hybrid office software rather than an IWMS, CAFM platform, enterprise facilities suite, or interactive floor-plan system. It is designed for practical office scheduling, desk booking, hybrid team coordination, and workplace visibility within Slack and Teams.


## Which Slack Desk Booking Approach Fits Your Team?


Choose the workflow that matches how employees plan their office time and the operational tasks your workplace team needs to support.


**Officely may fit your team if you want to:**


- Book desks from Slack or Microsoft Teams.
- Let employees update their work location in the same collaboration platform.
- Show who plans to attend before colleagues choose an office day.
- Use real-time availability to guide desk selection.
- Review office-use analytics and planned attendance.
- Keep hybrid work software focused on scheduling, hot desk booking, and coordination.


**Envoy’s Slack integration may fit your team if you also need:**


- Visitor invitations through Slack.
- Visitor and delivery notifications.
- Meeting-room check-ins.
- On-site registration and check-in or check-out commands.
- Work-location sharing through Slack status.
- One-click responses to supported notifications.


The decision depends on your preferred employee workflow and required operational scope. Test the most common journey with a representative group: choose an office day, find colleagues, check availability, reserve a desk, and review the result.


> **See how Officely fits your collaboration platform.**
> Try or request a demo of Officely in Slack or Microsoft Teams, then assess the workflow against your office-booking requirements.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### Is Officely available on Slack Enterprise Grid?


No. Officely is not currently available to customers on Slack Enterprise Grid[\[3\]](https://slack.com/marketplace/A018RKTRY8P-officely-desk-booking) . Confirm your organization’s Slack plan before selecting it for a company-wide rollout.
